main.description: Who maintains a package, and how many of them must attest a release or a change of maintainers. A change counts once the previous record's 'ownerThreshold' of owners have attested it.

threshold.description: How many maintainers must attest a release.

ownerThreshold.description: How many owners must attest a change to this record.

humans.description: How many of a release's attestations must come from maintainers that are not automation.

approvalKeysRequired.description: Whether every person's attestation needs an approval signed by one of their approval keys.

maintainer.description: One maintainer: exactly one of 'did', 'commitment', or 'org' with 'team'.

commitment.description: A commitment to a private 'dev.zena-lang.org.defs#entry', in place of a DID.

org.description: With 'team': the organization whose team maintains the package.

team.description: The team's name in 'org'. Every member of the team has 'role'.
